svg.title: Projects, extensions, and starting agent work
svg.desc: Project identity resolves to a git main checkout, while workspaces are execution checkouts. One running extension can reach multiple permitted projects. Approval of code or trust in its source is separate from per-project settings. Activity decisions and bounded startWork preserve project account eligibility and session provenance.
